offer_transfer.conditions: participation/settled_amount may reference previously visible offers and test this TURN. arrived_amount references an actual public shipment choice ID and tests prior arrivals. Only structured conditions gate execution; body is not an additional executable condition.
offer_transfer.effect: Standing one-shot offer of your own resource through an existing route. ID is offer:{actor}:{id}. Exact terms reach target next TURN. No shipment until target accepts. Remains pending until withdrawn, rejected or attempted; no automatic retry after settlement.

respond_transfer.effect: Only the target can accept or reject an exact visible offer. Acceptance attempts it once this TURN, subject to current physical laws and any sender withdrawal. Rejection closes the offer.

withdraw_transfer.effect: Only the sender can withdraw its pending offer. Withdrawal prevents dispatch even if the recipient accepts in the same TURN.

capabilities.addressed_messages: Sender and listed recipients only; available next TURN.
capabilities.other_activity_requests: Free body/operation/arguments are retained verbatim. Unconnected operations have no physical effect; no prose-to-physics interpreter exists.
capabilities.round_timing: All inputs freeze together. Current messages/offers arrive next TURN. Existing consumption, production and transit advance once per TURN.
capabilities.world_visibility: Physical stocks, production, network and actual shipments are public. Private messages, notes and pending offers are not.

physical_rules.capacity: per-turn throughput; dispatch reserves capacity, not future route occupancy
physical_rules.production: shared-input proportional scale; whole batches; frozen inputs; delayed outputs
physical_rules.recovery: no effect until an explicit recovery law is approved
